items.note: Untradeable. Must be mined in Lovakengj.

items.name: Dark essence block
items.note: Untradeable. Mine a Dense essence block in Arceuus then use the Dark Altar.

items.name: Runes/equipment to cast FIRE bolt or better
Melee combat gear to fight Judge of Yama
items.note: Judge of Yama is immune to range and magic attacks.

items.name: Melee or range gear to fight Xamphur.
items.note: Xamphur is immune to magic attacks.

items.name: Staff for Fairy rings or a Skills Necklace
Games necklace for Wintertodt camp teleport

steps.text: Talk to Martin Holt east of Kourend Castle.
bring: Melee combat gear to fight Judge of Yama

steps.text: Talk to Commander Fullore in Kourend Castle.
Search the Councillor's home east of Kourend castle for clues.
Speak with Tomas Lawry on the ground floor of the Councillor's home.
chat: I've found something that might be useful.

steps.text: Talk to Fuggy in the pub in southeast Lovakengj.
chat: Had any councillors stay here recently?

steps.text: Talk to Cabin Boy Herbert next to Veos's ship in Port Piscarilius, ready to fight the Judge of Yama.
Fight the Judge of Yama. This boss uses magic + range prayer so melee is required. Run in the gaps of the fire waves to approach the boss.
Talk to Commander Fullore in Kourend Castle.
Talk to Commander Fullore just south of the Kourend Castle.
Talk to Martin Holt again east of the Kourend Castle.
Pickpocket Istoria in the Arceuus Historical Archives to get the bluish key.
Search the display case in the south east corner of the Arceuus Historical Archives to get Rose's diary.
Talk to Martin Holt again east of the Kourend Castle.
Read Rose's note that fell out of the diary.
Talk to Martin Holt again east of the Kourend Castle.
Talk to Martin Holt on the north side of the Forthos Ruins.
bring: Runes/equipment to cast FIRE bolt or better
Games necklace for Wintertodt camp teleport
Staff for Fairy rings or a Skills Necklace

steps.text: Chop the vines south of Martin Holt.
Solve the wall panel puzzle.
Read Rose's note from the panel on the wall.
Talk to Martin Holt again on the north side of the Forthos Ruins.
Talk to Martin Holt again in the Settlement Ruins south west of the Wintertodt camp. Be prepared to fight a level 132 assassin who uses a dragon dagger and dragon darts.
Kill the Assassin.
Talk to Martin Holt again in the Settlement Ruins south west of the Wintertodt camp.
Work out what to do to unlock the next wall panel.
Open the panel on the wall in the Settlement Ruins.
Read Rose's note from the panel on the wall.
Talk to Martin Holt in the Settlement Ruins again.
Talk to Martin Holt at the Legless Faun pub in the south west corner of Port Piscarilius.
Check the panel on the wall again.
Read Rose's note from the panel on the wall.
Inspect the crates in the north west corner of the shack located north east of the farming guild.
Watch the cutscene.
Enter the Lizard Dwelling south east of the Farming guild.
bring: Staff for Fairy rings or a Skills Necklace
Melee or range gear to fight Xamphur.

steps.text: Talk to Kaht B'alam located on the east side of the middle tunnel.
chat: Do you think you could help me find a mage?

steps.text: Search the Lizardman eggs found in the Kebos Lowlands until you find a Lizardman egg. You will be attacked by a level 75 lizardman but you do not need to kill it.
Return to Kaht B'alam with the Lizardman egg.
Open and enter the door near Kaht B'alam with the damp key.
chat: So about the door over there...

steps.text: Fight Xamphur.
Watch the Xamphur cutscene.
Search the table in the north of the room you fought Xamphur for some notes.
Return to Commandore Fullore in the shack basement north east of the Farming guild.
Watch the cutscene.
Speak to Lord Arceuus in the Tower of Magic, north west of Arceuus.
Speak to Lord Hosidius in his home on the south east side of Hosidius.
Speak to Lady Lovakengj in the Lovakengj Assembly.
Speak to Lady Piscarilius in the sewers under Port Piscarilius.
Speak to Lord Shayzien upstairs of the War Tent in the Shayzien Encampment.
Speak to Commander Fullore at Xeric's Lookout located south east of Shayzien.
Speak with all the leaders again on each floor of Xeric's Lookout. Lord Hosidius can be found in the basement and Lord Arceuus just outside the door of the Lookout.
Speak to Commander Fullore in Xeric's Lookout about Lady Lovakengj.
bring: Games necklace for Wintertodt camp teleport
chat: I need some help with Lady Lovakengj.

steps.text: Go to Mount Karuulm, go down the elevator, and speak with Kaal-Mej-San.
Mix the Defence potion with the Volcanic sulphur.
Talk to Kaal-Mej-San again.
Use the Shielding potion on the Doors of Dinh in the Wintertodt camp.
Fight and kill the Barbarian Warlord (level 91) in the Kourend Woodlands.
Talk to Phileas Rimor in the Barbarian Warlords prison.
Talk to Martin Holt in the Shayzien Prison west of the Graveyard of Heroes.
Speak with Jorra south of the Graveyard of Heroes in Shayzien then fight the Assassin (level 132).
chat: Evil only triumphs when the good do nothing.

steps.text: Speak with Jorra again.
Talk to Mori on the top floor of the Arceuus church.
Enter the Chasm of Fire.
Inspect the eastern wine barrel in the Hosidius vinery then enter it. Once inside, picklock the chest to receive a Shayzien journal.
Speak with all the leaders again on each floor of Xeric's Lookout.
Speak to Commander Fullore at Xeric's Lookout.
Watch cutscene.
Speak to Commander Fullore again at Xeric's Lookout.
Speak with Lord Hosidius in Xeric's Lookout basement.
Speak to Commander Fullore to begin the final cutscene.
Watch the final cutscene.
Speak with Commander Fullore in Kourend Castle to finish the quest.

items.name: Ghostspeak amulet
items.note: Morytania legs 2+ work as well.

steps.text: Speak with the Mysterious Stranger in Ver Sinhaza.
chat: What's this thing you need from me?

steps.text: Enter the crypts north east of the Mysterious Stranger.
Kill a vyrewatch for a key. You must have your flail equipped in order to damage the vyrewatches.
Unlock the crypt gate with the key.
Search the coffin.
Return to the Mysterious Stranger with Ranis' head.
chat: I managed to recover Ranis' head.

steps.text: Speak to the Mysterious Stranger some more.
chat: So what are we doing with Ranis' head?

steps.text: Enter the spider cave south of Port Phasmatys.
Search the skeleton found near the Egg Sac at the end of the cave.
Read the Sticky note.
Speak with Daer Krand found in the north east corner of the main room of the Sisterhood Sanctuary in Slepe.
Return to the spider cave south of Port Phasmatys then use the Sulphuric acid on the Egg sac at the end of the cave.
Speak with the Mysterious Stranger in Ver Sinhaza again with the spider eggs retrieved from the Egg sac. Use the Drakan's Medallion tele to get to Ver Sinhaza quickly.
chat: I found some of those eggs.

steps.text: Watch cutscenes.
Go to the Nature Grotto in the Mort Myre Swamp and speak with the Nature Spirit inside. Use fairy ring BIP (with 50 agility) to get there quickly.
Fight Hespori.
Chop Hespori to obtain Hespori bark.
Speak with the Mysterious Stranger in Ver Sinhaza again with the Hespori bark. Use the Drakan's Medallion tele to get to Ver Sinhaza quickly.
Watch cutscenes.
Complete the Theatre of Blood.
Speak with the Mysterious Stranger in Ver Sinhaza and watch the cutscenes to finish the quest.
chat: Did you manage to get any useful memories from Verzik?

items.name: A knife or slash weapon
items.note: Except abyssal whip, abyssal tentacle, noxious halberd, or dragon claws.

steps.text: Read the notice board in Draynor Village.
Talk to Sarah in the South Falador Farm.
Use a rope on the Strange Hole east of Draynor Manor.
chat: I think that'll be all for now.

steps.text: Climb down into the Strange Hole east of Draynor Manor.
Go to the end of the cave and investigate the skeleton there.
Talk to Spria in Draynor Village.
Climb down into the Strange Hole east of Draynor Manor. Be prepared to fight Sourhog (level 37)
Kill Sourhog.
Cut off Sourhog's foot.
Return to Sarah in the South Falador Farm.
Return to Spria in Draynor Village.
Talk to Launa east of Varrock.
chat: Would you like me to go down to look for your husband and son?

steps.text: Use a rope on the rift.
Enter the rift.
Take a weapon from the weapon rack. Kill the angry monsters with the appropriate weapon:
Go to the next room.
Look inside the Dark Holes to cause fear reapers to appear. Kill 5 of them. You cannot search the same hole over and over again.
Continue to the next room.
Attack the confusion beasts until you find one which takes damage, and kill it. The others will take 8 hits to die.
Leave the room through the confusing door.
Kill each hopeless creature 3 times.
Continue through the exit of the room.
Kill all three of Tolna's heads.
Talk to Tolna.
Talk to Tolna outside the rift.

items.name: Catspeak amulet
items.note: You can get another from the Sphinx in Sophanem

steps.text: Talk to Unferth in north east Burthorpe.
Talk to Hild in the house north east of Unferth.
Operate the catspeak amulet (e) to locate Bob the Cat. He's often in Catherby Archery Shop or at the Varrock Anvil.
Talk to Bob the Cat.
Talk to Gertrude west of Varrock.
Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Castle's library.
chat: I have a cat related question.

steps.text: Use the catspeak amulet (e) again to locate Bob the Cat.
Talk to Bob the Cat again.
Talk to the Sphinx in Sophanem.
chat: Ask the Sphinx for help for Bob.

steps.text: Rake Unferth's patch
Plant 4 potato seeds in Unferth's patch. These can take 15-35 minutes to grow.
Make Unferth's bed.
Use logs on Unferth's fireplace
Use a tinderbox on Unferth's fireplace.
USE a chocolate cake on Unferth's table.
Use a bucket of milk on Unferth's table.
Use some shears on Unferth in north east Burthorpe.
Talk to Unferth in north east Burthorpe again.
Talk to the Apothecary in south west Varrock.
chat: Talk about A Tail of Two Cats.

steps.text: Talk to Unferth whilst wearing the doctor/nurse hat, a desert shirt and a desert robe, and no weapon/shield.
Use the catspeak amulet (e) to locate Bob once more.
Talk to Bob the Cat again.
Talk to Unferth to complete the quest.

items.name: Rod of Ivandis
items.note: You can get another from Veliaf Hurtz in Burgh de Rott AFTER talking to Verdita in Old Man Ral's basement during the quest

items.name: Runes or tablet for Enchant Emerald
Any pickaxe
items.note: You can get one from one of the miners in the mine

steps.text: Talk to Garth outside the Theatre of Blood.
Enter the Meiyerditch Myreque base. The easiest way to get there is to have a Vyrewatch take you to the mines, escape by mining 15 rocks, then head south from there.
Talk to Safalaan in the north room.
Return to the Theatre of Blood and attempt to climb rubble in its south west corner.
Talk to Harpert near the rubble.
Attempt to climb the rubble again.
Climb the vent to the north when the steam stops coming out.
Jump off the roof to the north.
Climb the vent to the north when steam stops coming out.
Climb the roof to the east.
Climb down to the east.
Look through the window at the end of the path.
Return to the Meiyerditch Myreque base. The easiest way to get there is to have a Vyrewatch take you to the mines, escape by mining 15 rocks, then head south from there.
Talk to Safalaan in the north room.
Talk to Flaygian.
Talk to Safalaan again.
Enter Serafina's house in west Meiyerditch.
Talk to Safalaan.
Work out how to open the door in the room.
Search the chest for some notes.
Talk to Safalaan with the notes.
Prepare for a fight, then return to the Meiyerditch Myreque base.
Talk to Safalaan, ready for a fight.
Kill the abomination. It can be safe spotted with a long-ranged weapon.
Talk to Safalaan.
Climb down the trapdoor in Old Man Ral's house in south west Meiyerditch.
bring: Runes or tablet for Enchant Emerald

steps.text: Talk to Safalaan.
Talk to Vertida.
Read Flaygian's notes.
Search the north west crate for a blessed sickle.
Search the south east crate for a chain.
Use an emerald on the blessed sickle.
Cast enchant emerald on the emerald sickle.
Add the enchanted emerald sickle to the rod of ivandis.
Talk to Safalaan again.
Talk to Kael outside the Theatre of Blood, prepared to fight Ranis.
Defeat Ranis.
Talk to Kael outside the Theatre of Blood again.
Climb down the trapdoor in Old Man Ral's house in south west Meiyerditch.
Talk to Safalaan to complete the quest!
Talk to a barbarian guard outside the Barbarian Agility Course at the Barbarian Outpost to learn about Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl.
chat: I want to come through this gate.
Looks can be deceiving, I am in fact a barbarian.

steps.text: Talk to the bartender in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
Talk to the bartender in the Jolly Boar Inn north east of Varrock.
Talk to a bartender in the Rising Sun Inn in Falador.
Talk to the bartender in the Rusty Anchor in Port Sarim.
Talk to Zembo in the Karamja Spirits Bar on Musa Point.
Talk to the bartender in the Dead Man's Chest in Brimhaven.
Talk to the bartender in the Flying Horse Inn in Ardougne.
Talk to the bartender in the Forester's Arms in Seers' Village.
Talk to Blurberry in the Grand Tree.
Talk to the bartender in Dragon Inn in Yanille.
Return to the barbarian guards outside the Barbarian Agility Course.
Talk to Ava to begin the quest.
chat: I would be happy to make your home a better place.

steps.text: Talk to Malcolm at the farm west of the Ectofuntus.
Talk to Alice.
Talk to Malcolm again.
Talk to Alice again.
Talk to the Old crone just east of the Slayer Tower twice.
chat: I'm here about the farmers east of here.

steps.text: Give the Crone-made amulet to Malcolm.
chat: Okay, you need it more than I do, I suppose.

steps.text: Talk to Malcolm again to watch a cutscene.
Buy two undead chickens from Malcolm. You can acquire ecto-tokens using the Ectofuntus to the east.
chat: Could I buy those chickens now, then?

steps.text: Give the two Undead chickens to Ava.
Talk to the witch in the manor twice.
Go to the iron mine in Rimmington northeast of the house portal.
While looking north, use the hammer on the Selected iron.
Give the Bar magnet to Ava.
Try to chop an undead tree outside Draynor manor.
Talk to Turael in Burthorpe twice, giving him the Mithril axe and Holy symbol.
chat: Hello, I'm here about those trees again.

steps.text: Try to chop an undead tree outside Draynor manor with the Blessed axe until you receive undead twigs.
Give the Undead twigs to Ava.
Talk to Ava to receive the research notes.
Translate the research notes.
Give Ava the translated research notes.
Combine Hard leather and Polished buttons with the pattern.
Give Ava the container.
Travel to Dorgesh-Kaan under Lumbridge, and talk to Ur-tag there.
Talk to Tegdak through the doorway in south-west Dorgesh-Kaan.
Dig up the 6 artefacts in the railway tunnel, clean them, and show them to Tegdak.
Talk to Zanik in the railway, and then go talk to the Goblin Scribe in the north of Dorgesh-Kaan with her.
Talk to Oldak in the north west of Dorgesh-Kaan with Zanik.
Talk to General Wartface and General Bentnoze in Goblin Village.
Make your way to the tower to the south, using the buildings as cover, and climb up the ladder.
Kill the H.A.M. Mage and H.A.M. Archer with a ranged/magic weapon.
Talk to General Wartface and General Bentnoze in Goblin Village again.
Talk to the Sergeants in Lumbridge Swamp.
Enter the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
Climb down the ladder to the secret H.A.M. base.
Hide behind the marked crate, and wait for the guards to walk past and around the corner.
Run out in front of the final guard, and wait for one of the sergeants to attack them.
Climb down the ladder.
When Sigmund starts using protection prayers, use the ancient mace's special attack on Sigmund to remove them and then defeat him.
Untie Zanik.
Talk to Mori in Arceuus.
chat: What can I do to help?
We should let someone know about this.

steps.text: Talk to Councillor Andrews in Kourend Castle.
chat: There's been a death in Arceuus.

steps.text: Return to Mori in Arceuus.
Enter the Tower of Magic in Arceuus, ready to fight some level 16 Tormented Souls.
Defeat the tormented souls.
Go up the stairs in the Tower of Magic.
Talk to Lord Trobin Arceuus.
Talk to Kaal-Ket-Jor.
Inspect the ancient grave south of Mount Karuulm.
Inspect plants and bushes until you uncover the full path.
Inspect the final plant and kill the Trapped Soul (level 30) which appears.
Return to Kaal-Ket-Jor.
Inspect the rocks near the Arceuus Altar until you find a device.
Talk to Lord Trobin Arceuus to finish the quest.

items.name: 2 Jerboa tails, or a box trap to get some
Hammer
items.note: Can be obtained during the quest.

items.name: Needle or Costume needle
items.note: Can be obtained during the quest.

steps.text: Talk to Guildmaster Apatura in the Hunter Guild, south-west of Civitas illa Fortis.
chat: Can I help you with anything?

steps.text: Go down the stairs in the tree in the guild.
Talk to Guild Scribe Verity behind the bar.
Talk to Guild Hunter Wolf (Master), next to the bar.
Wind up a toy mouse.
Use the wound up toy mouse on Guild Hunter Kiko near the bar.
Check the cat's bed.
Return to Guild Hunter Wolf (Master), next to the bar.
Go back up the stairs.
bring: Jerboa tail, or a box trap to get some

steps.text: Get a box trap. You can buy one from Imia in the north of the Hunter Guild's surface for 41gp.
Talk to Guild Hunter Fox near the crevice south-east of the Hunter Guild.
Search the leafy bush south of the crevice for a smooth leaf.
Search the rough-looking bush on the west side of the Locus Oasis.
Catch two Embertailed Jerboa for their tails.
Use the tails on the leaves.
Bring the poultice back to Guild Hunter Fox near the crevice.
Talk to Guild Hunter Fox.
Talk to Atza in one of the buildings outside Civitas illa Fortis' south wall, west of the general store.
Take a hammer from the house north of Atza.
Set-up the pile of equipment next to Atza.
Talk to Atza again for some trimmed fur.
Return to Guild Hunter Fox near the crevice south-east of the Hunter Guild to get his report.
Take the needle in the Hunter Guild's surface area, in its south-east corner.
Go down the stairs in the tree in the Hunters Guild.
Talk to Guild Scribe Verity behind the bar again.
Use a jerboa tail on the cat bed.
Go back up the stairs and talk to Guildmaster Apatura to finish the quest.

items.name: Any seed that can be planted directly

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about fishing.
chat: What can I learn about the use of a fishing rod?

steps.text: Search the bed in Otto's hut.
Fish from one of the fishing spots near Otto's hut.
Return to Otto and tell him about your success.
chat: I've fished with a barbarian rod!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about herblore.
chat: What was that secret knowledge of herblore we talked of?

steps.text: Fish from one of the fishing spots near Otto's hut.
Dissect the fish with a knife until you get some roe.
Use roe on an attack potion (2).
Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about barehand fishing.
chat: Please teach me of your cunning with harpoons.

steps.text: Fish in a fishing spot which requires a harpoon WITHOUT a harpoon.
Return to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about farming.
bring: Any seed that can be planted directly
chat: How can I use my strength in the ways of agriculture?

steps.text: Plant a seed in a patch WITHOUT a dibber. This can fail, so bring multiple and preferably use cheap seeds.
Return to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
chat: I've planted seeds with my fists!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about advanced farming.
chat: Are there any other fist related farming activities I can learn?

steps.text: Plant a sapling in a tree or fruit tree patch.
Return to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
chat: I've smashed a pot whilst farming!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about firemaking.
chat: I'm ready for your firemaking wisdom. Please instruct me.

steps.text: Use a bow on some oak logs to light it.
Return to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
chat: I've set fire to logs with a bow!

steps.text: Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about spears.
chat: Tell me more about the use of spears.

steps.text: Make a bronze spear on the anvil south of Otto.
Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about hastae.
chat: Tell me more about the use of spears.

steps.text: Make a bronze hasta on the anvil south of Otto.
Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls.
Talk to Otto in his hut north-west of Baxtorian Falls about advanced firemaking.
chat: I have completed firemaking with a bow. What follows this?

steps.text: Jump into the whirlpool north of Otto. Be prepared to fight mithril dragons.
Climb down the stairs. There are brutal green dragons there, so have antifire protection and Protect from Magic on!
Climb up the stairs to the south-east. Be ready to fight the mithril dragons!
Kill mithril dragons until you get some chewed bones.
Pick up the chewed bones.
Construct a pyre on the lake near Otto.
Return to Otto and tell him about the succesful pyre-making.

items.name: Dusty key, or another way to get into the deep Taverley Dungeon

steps.text: Go to the Arceuus library and find The Soul journey book in one of the bookcases, then read it. You can ask Biblia for help locating it, or make use of the Runelite Kourend Library plugin.
Talk to Aretha at the Soul Altar.
Go to the Arceuus church and dig for the Damaged soul bearer.
Go to Taverley Dungeon, or teleport to the Key Master directly.
bring: Dusty key, or another way to get into the deep Taverley Dungeon

steps.text: Enter the cave to the Key Master.
Talk to Key Master in the Cerberus' Lair.

items.name: Cooked Meat
items.note: Can be obtained during the quest.

items.name: A teleport to near Ice Mountain
Combat gear or a pickaxe if you don't want to fight

steps.text: Talk to Willow outside Falador, south of the Ice Mountain dwarves.
Attempt to recruit Checkal to your team in Barbarian Village.
Speak to Atlas in the Barbarian Village Inn to learn how to Flex. Pick up a cooked meat if you need one.
Talk to Checkal and flex your muscles to prove your worth.
Speak to Marley in the Edgeville Ruins. Pick up the cooked meat from the Barbarian longhall if you don't have it already.
Ask the Cook at the Blue Moon Inn for a steak sandwich.
chat: I was wondering if you'd be able to make me a Steak sandwich?

steps.text: Collect meat, bread and a knife to make a steak sandwich.
Use the knife on the bread to make a steak sandwich. Be careful not to eat it!
Return to Marley and give him the steak sandwich. Be careful not to eat it!
Talk to Burntof in the Falador Inn.
Buy an Asgarnian Ale for Burntof.
Give Burntof the Asgarnian Ale.
Beat Burntof in a match of Rock-Paper-Scissors. Your choices of Rock, Paper and Scissors do not matter.
Talk with Willow at the dungeon entrance on the west side of Ice Mountain.
bring: Combat gear or a pickaxe if you don't want to fight

steps.text: Defeat the Lvl-25 Ancient Guardian. Alternatively, with Level 10 Mining, mine the 4 pillars in the corners.
Watch the cutscene to finish the quest.

items.note: Can be obtained during the quest.

items.note: Can be obtained during the quest.

items.note: Purchasable from a shop during the quest. Fish will NOT work

items.name: Pharaoh's sceptre
items.note: When visiting Necropolis during the quest, you can unlock the direct teleport by using 'Commune' on the Obelisk.

steps.text: Talk to Jamila in Sophanem to start the quest.
Read the message.
Talk to Maisa at the campsite east of Sophanem, and investigate the excavation.
Inspect the blocked entry at the Jaltevas Pyramid.
Prepare to fight the Head Menaphite Guard, and talk to either a citizen or Menaphite Guard to start the fight.
Fight the Head Menaphite Guard. This boss uses melee, and can hit up to 16. DO NOT USE ANY OVERHEAD PROTECTION PRAYERS, OR YOU WILL GET HIT FOR 1/3RD OF YOUR HITPOINTS
Talk to Maisa to continue the quest.
Go back to Maisa's camp and talk to her.
From the campsite, head south and then to the east, around the cliffs, where you will find a set of stairs to the Ruins of Ullek.
Work out how to unlock the underground entrance west of the obelisk in Ullek.
Inspect the pillar to the north to insert the emblem.
Work out how to unlock the underground entrance west of the obelisk in Ullek.
Enter the dungeon.
Use Protect from Magic and defeat the two Scarab Mages.
Climb down the stairs.
Avoid the projectiles, run west to the junction, run south, follow the corridor, and pull the lever at the end.
As fast as possible, run back to the juncture, then run north and pull the second lever.
With the traps disabled, go through the door west of the juncture.
Solve the tomb riddle.
Enter the tomb.
Speak to the Spirit.
Take the rusty key from the urn in the back of the room.
Prepare to fight the Champion of Scabaras, and unlock the door to start the fight.
Fight the Champion of Scabaras.
Talk to the High Priest of Scabaras.
Talk to Maisa or Zahur in Nardah.
Purchase some meat from the General Store.
Head west and attempt to jump to the stepping stones over the River Elid.
Attempt to cross the stepping stones again, and pick the Lily of the Elid.
Go back to Zahur in Nardah.
Talk to Zahur in Nardah.
Warm up Zahur's Chemistry Equipment.
Bring the cure crate to the High Priest in Sophanem.
Prepare to fight the Menaphite Akh (lvl 351), and talk to Maisa in Necropolis when ready.

Defeat the Menaphite Akh. This boss uses melee, and will occasionally cast lightning in front of her, so be prepared to walk behind her to avoid this attack. Whenever a shadow version of them appears, kill them quickly as they'll deal a lot of damage.
Talk to Maisa or the High Priest in Sophanem to finish the quest.

items.name: Ammo mould
items.note: You can buy one from Nulodion above the Dwarven Mine for 5 coins

steps.text: Talk to Dondakan in the north of the mine.
chat: Why are you firing a cannon at a wall?
So why were you trying to get through the rock again?

steps.text: Talk to the Dwarven Engineer in west Keldagrim.
Talk to Rolad at the Ice Mountain entrance to the Dwarven Mine. If you don't have an ammo mould, buy one from Nulodion whilst you're here.
Enter the Dwarven Mine.
Search the mine carts for a page.
Kill scorpions for a page.
Mine low level rocks for a page.
Talk to Rolad again.
Read the entire dwarven lore book.
Return to Dondakan with the book and a gold bar.
Use a gold bar on Dondakan.
Use a gold bar on a furnace to make a gold cannonball.
Use a gold cannon ball on Dondakan.
chat: Yes, I'm sure this will crack open the rock.
